findings.summary: This is a fix-type change and the diff appends the reproducing test into the pre-existing tests/test_calc.py instead of a new file, so the framework's test-file check (which flags any diff touching a test file that existed before the fix, append-only or not, as its own fixtures demonstrate) is breached even though no existing test's code was changed.

The Layout line "percent(part, whole) ... raises the same on a zero whole" is ambiguous after this change: percent now raises a different message than divide, so a reader could take "the same" to mean the same error text, not just the same exception type (intent.md/spec.md address this and read it as type-only, which is a defensible but not certain reading).
